perks.name: Resonant Plating
perks.description: Your health begins regenerating immediately after taking melee damage from a powerful combatant.
perks.exact:
Upon receiving a Melee Attack from a Miniboss+ Combatant:
Begins Health Regeneration.

perks.name: Siphoning Touch
perks.description: Gain stacks of Siphoning Touch for weapon or Glaive melee hits. Switching weapons heals you and consumes all stacks.
perks.exact:
Upon scoring weapon damage instances or a Glaive Melee Attack:
Grants a stack of Siphoning Touch, up to a maximum of 5 stacks.
x1 = ~26.7% of Mag | x2 = ~53.4% | x3 = ~80% | x4 = ~106% | x5 = ~133%
Scorch does not count for damage instances. Always rounds down.

On Weapon Stow:
Consumes all Siphoning Touch to restores HP, based on the stack amount.
30 | 60 | 90 | 105 | 120 HP restored.

item.name: Solar Resistance
item.description: Reduces incoming Solar damage from combatants.
item.exact:
15% | 25% | 30% Damage Resist against Combatants.

Elemental Mods reduce Mod-Matching Elemental damage.
Sniper reduces damage from >30 metres.
Melee reduces damage from <5 metres.
Concussive Dampener reduces AoE/Blast/Explosive Damage.

Different Resist Mods, as well as other sources of Resist all stack multiplicatively with each other.
